capability.summary: Estimate a population-level age from one first name
capability.description: Calls Agify.io's fixed name endpoint to estimate age and sample count for one first name; it is demographic estimation, not identity lookup or age verification. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
capability.problem_space: Population-level first-name age estimation; not personal identification, demographics beyond the returned estimate, or deterministic computation.

constraint.io_signature: Input: one first-name string; output: JSON envelope from the wrapper containing Agify's age/count or HTTP error body with http_status. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
constraint.output_shape: HTTP 2xx/3xx: {status: "success", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}. HTTP 4xx/5xx: {status: "error", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}, exit 1. Request exception: {status: "error", tool: string, message: string}, exit 1.
limitations: fixed GET https://api.agify.io/ with query name=<name>; no batch input or caller-selected endpoint
HTTP 400-599 responses and request exceptions produce status=error
HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
no auth, local cache, retry, or caller-selectable timeout; shared helper uses 25 seconds and User-Agent S-GAR/1.0
estimate depends on Agify's current population data and is not a verified individual's age

output_contract.description: JSON envelope containing Agify's first-name age estimate and count, plus requested URL and HTTP status.

intent_tags: estimate age from a first name
negative_intents: identify a person or retrieve a personal profile

output_contract.description: JSON envelope containing Agify's first-name age estimate and count, plus requested URL and HTTP status.
